question: A 24-year-old boy who, after 3 days of high-risk sexual contact, has numerous pustular, small, very pruritic lesions that progress to minute erosions affecting the entire glans and inner face of the prepuce. Indicate which is, among the following, the most probable diagnostic orientation:
analysis: Based on the presentation of numerous pustular, pruritic lesions progressing to erosions on the glans and inner face of the prepuce following high-risk sexual contact, the most probable diagnostic orientation is secondary syphilis.
